name: Proton Calendar
author: loneycoffee
description: Omarchy's clock and month calendar with your Proton Calendar events: a dot under each day that has some, the day's agenda (for today, what is still to come), the next event on the bar as it gets close, and a reminder before it starts. Reads calendars through their 'Share with anyone' links. A drop-in replacement for omarchy.clock. Toggle the panel with: omarchy-shell shell toggle proton-calendar

barWidget.description: Clock with a calendar of your Proton Calendar events

schema.label: Show the next event on the bar this many minutes ahead (0 = never)
